arguments.text: Implemented evaluate(request, evidence, policy) in work.py. Eligibility is determined only from supplied arguments: matching claim, not withdrawn, verified exactly true when required, and canonical-JSON equality for every policy-required condition. Missing required request conditions return unknown with sorted names; eligible superseders remove referenced source IDs; no evidence, conflict, supported, and Boolean-false unsupported outputs follow the exact four-field schema. report.json contains the two current request results. Local tests passed for input immutability, missing conditions, verification filtering, ineligible superseders, source-count conflicts, canonical object agreement, JSON numeric-form disagreement, absent calibration, report parity, compilation, and schema shape.

Unresolved limits: the task does not define malformed-input behavior (non-JSON values, missing/non-string source IDs, malformed conditions/supersedes, duplicate source IDs) or transitive/cyclic supersession semantics. Current implementation assumes valid JSON-shaped inputs and removes any eligible record whose source is directly named by another eligible record. Canonical JSON serialization intentionally distinguishes 1 from 1.0 and rejects NaN/Infinity.
